query.created_from: matching typed request field; nil optional omitted; explicit zero/false/empty retained; repeated provider_keys preserved
query.created_to: matching typed request field; nil optional omitted; explicit zero/false/empty retained; repeated provider_keys preserved
query.balances: matching typed request field; nil optional omitted; explicit zero/false/empty retained; repeated provider_keys preserved
query.offset: matching typed request field; nil optional omitted; explicit zero/false/empty retained; repeated provider_keys preserved

request.validation: Published provider enum, year2020..2030/month1..12, locale ru/en, date-time offset or source example timezone-free form, transactions limit1..500 and arbitrary-precision nonnegative offset; no defaults added

response.field_mapping: All source fields, recursive report objects and integer/string project IDs retained. Exact Integer quantities; source money->Amount.Raw with unit kopeck, no inferred currency. ProviderTimestamp.Raw retained, UTC only when offset supplied. Names/descriptions/service context/debt reasons protected; optional null preserved with Nullable or formatter-safe OptionalText.
response.resource_ref: none; billing project/object identifiers are billing metadata, never infrastructure adoption refs

errors.over_requested_page_limit: response_limit with retained bounded prefix, no completion claim

retry: bounded safe reads within CallTimeout; no endpoint/credential-scope fallback

pagination.mode: one caller-selected offset page; optional offset omitted when absent; required limit1..500
pagination.completion: not inferred; source publishes no next/total/end metadata
pagination.budget: MaxJSONBytes; excess returned rows truncated with response_limit

wait.availability: unavailable; financial read does not create/wait resources

timeout: CallTimeout and MaxJSONBytes; no unbounded buffering
limitations: Caller must configure endpoint; source/server availability is not established

source_example_compatibility.ServerMeta.ru: source schema requires ru but its own 200 example omits it; accept documented en-only example while keeping other required fields
